description: This file contains shell script code for testing the migration of Git ref storage backends, including functions for reflog entries, migration procedures, and various test cases for different repository states and formats.

methods.name: print_all_reflog_entries
methods.description: Function to print all reflog entries for a given repository, iterating through reflogs and outputting each entry.

methods.name: test_migration
methods.description: Function to perform migration of refs in a repository from one format to another, verifying correctness of refs and reflogs.
